articles.title: Zoom! IndyCar Racers Take Over Washington D.C.'s National Mall
articles.summary: Imagine race cars speeding past the Capitol building! This weekend, the first-ever IndyCar race in Washington D.C. happens on the National Mall. It's a one-time event for America's 250th birthday, and 140,000 fans are expected each day.

articles.title: Arsenal Snags Star Defender Ezri Konsa for a Whopping £51 Million!
articles.summary: Arsenal just signed England defender Ezri Konsa from Aston Villa for £51 million! He's joining the Premier League champions to help them win again. Konsa says he's hungry to win and can't wait to get started.

articles.title: Prince Harry and Celebrities Face Huge Legal Bill After Losing Privacy Case
articles.summary: Prince Harry and six other famous people lost a privacy case against the Daily Mail's publisher. Now a judge says they must pay up to £34.5 million in legal costs. That's a lot of money—way more than they expected!
